OakSpeechText1.en:
(We meet) for the first time! To the world of Pocket Monsters, welcome!

My name is Okido. By everyone (I) am looked up to as the Pokémon professor.
OakSpeechText1.loose: Nice to meet you! Welcome to the world of Pocket Monsters! My name is Oak. People call me the Pokémon professor.

OakSpeechText2.en:
In this world, living things called Pocket Monsters live everywhere!

Those living things called Pokémon, people make into pets, or use in matches...

And...

I am doing research on these Pokémon, that's what it is.

IntroducePlayerText.en: Well then, first, your name, let (me) be told it!

IntroduceRivalText.en:
This guy is my grandchild. (He) is your childhood friend and is (your) rival.

...Er? What was (his) name again?

OakSpeechText3.en:
{player}!

At last, from now, the beginning of your story!

Dreams and adventure! To the world of Pocket Monsters! Let's go!

HisNameIsText.en: That's right, that's right! (I) remembered! (He) is the name {rival}.
HisNameIsText.loose: Right, I remember now! His name is {rival}.

HiraganaCharacters.en: The hiragana table, as laid out on the name-entry screen, with small ya yu yo tsu, dakuten, handakuten, the long-vowel mark, and a switch to katakana.

KatakanaCharacters.en: The katakana table, as laid out on the name-entry screen, with a switch to hiragana.

Dakutens.en: Pairs of plain and dakuten kana: ka ga, sa za, ta da, ha ba, and the same in katakana.

Handakutens.en: Pairs of plain and handakuten kana: ha pa, and the same in katakana.
